title: I Love the "Bagged Cordless Vac" Concept -- Very Unhappy With The Attachments
text:
I Love the "Bagged Cordless Vac" Concept -- Very Unhappy With The Attachments. As of the posting of this review, the cost for this vacuum here and at Oreck is $569.99. That's quite a premium for the wonderful new concept of making this kind of cordless hand vacuum with a bag (they call them "Pods") rather than the always messy and dirty and dusty collection containers. (I am surprised it took this long for someone to invent a "bagged" cordless hand vacuum...and bravo to Oreck for being the first to do it. Yes, one has to buy the replacement Pods--Oreck includes 5 with the vacuum--but they're only $15 for a 5-pack.)

While I love the bagged-cordless concept, I was disappointed with this vacuum overall, mostly having to do with attachments to be used when using it has a hand-held, and with its heavy weight, which can make it feel a bit uncomfortable rather quickly for those who are not as strong as some. (Please keep in mind that my primary use for this Oreck vac is as a handheld, and not for use as a floor vac.)

The worst attachment by far is the "Soft-Bristle Dust Brush tool. The black bristles shed immediately upon first use, and shed very badly. (And the first use was just over soft bed sheets.) The soft bristles have stretched outward/become deformed in several places, as well, and just won't stop shedding.

The second worst attachment is the small "AirPower Pivoting Brushroll Tool." The vacuum stops working when using this tool way too often and way too easily, where a red light comes on, as if the vacuum thinks the suction is being blocked. And I assure you I am not applying too much pressure when using this tool.

The Crevice Tool works as it should, but because the two release buttons are so far back, it is not the easiest to eject the tool right away, on the first attempt.

I do like that one does not have to hold the power button down for this to work. Turn the dial to power it on, and it stays on.

Suction in low power mode is a bit weak, but adequate for some easy-to-vacuum-up stuff. Suction in high power mode, which will make the battery power drain faster, of course, is very good.

And finally, I am disappointed they could not make this vacuum work while the a/c cord is plugged in charging the battery. This would have been a great emergency backup if the battery was dead and you wanted to still use this vacuum. But no, when the the electrical cord is plugged in, the vacuum will not turn on.

Edit 8-29-2018: Oreck sent me a 2nd soft bristle dust brush. And after I reported that that brush also shed and had deformed bristles they sent a 3rd. The 3rd brush also immediately shed quite badly just by very gently rubbing the brush over very soft material.
